findings.title: Increment retryCount atomically
findings.body: Both failure paths write `reminder.retryCount + 1` using the value loaded before the SMS call. If two cron invocations process the same reminder concurrently, they can both read the same count and overwrite it with the same next value. The failed attempts are then counted as one, so the reminder can be retried more than twice instead of being removed at the intended limit. Use Prisma's atomic `increment` update in both failure paths.
